title: The Central Terminal Platforms
statement:
Given the arrival and departure times of N trains at a railway station, find the minimum number of platforms required so that no train has to wait for a platform.

Arrival and departure times are given as integers in 24-hour military format (e.g. 900 for 09:00, 1530 for 15:30).
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated arrival times.
Third line: N space-separated departure times.
outputFormat: Print the minimum number of platforms.

sampleCases.explanation: At 11:00, 3 trains overlap on the station.
